units.source_text: 阿光很是可怜，身心每天都受到折磨。

en.t: Aguang was truly pitiful, tormented in body and mind every day.

units.source_text: 越受折磨，她的梦就越甜美。

en.t: The more she suffered, the sweeter her dreams became.

units.source_text: 然而，她已经不相信梦与现实之间有什么浮桥。

en.t: Yet she no longer believed there was any floating bridge between dreams and reality.

units.source_text: 相反，她能做的，就是跨上天马，随心所欲地从太空遨游到梦的世界……

en.t: Instead, all she could do was mount a heavenly horse and roam as she pleased from outer space into the world of dreams...
